title: 第25章 药家药炎第26章 身上沾满了诡异和不详
slug: 我的徒弟们都太逆天了
lines: 陆玄意念一动。
一道冷白色的火焰出现在他的掌心之中，其上流转着恐怖的灵纹封禁。
骨冷幽火，异火种子！
虽然这只是一个异火种子，但其蕴含的力量却是极其恐怖的！
若是解开封禁，恐怕产生一阵剧烈的波动。
一旁，叶尘有些震惊。
如此恐怖的灵火！
他看到灵火之上布满了诡秘的封禁，即使如此，他依旧感到一种心悸的冰寒之力。
接下来。
陆玄收起骨冷幽火，掌心之中出现了一枚丹药。
天阶洗髓丹！
洗精伐髓，提升资质，让人直接脱胎换骨！
叶尘再次震惊，因为他在这枚丹药之上，看到了好几道丹晕。
而且从丹药上泄露出的一丝气息来看，这枚丹药恐怕品阶极高！
他咽了咽唾沫。
陆玄收起了天阶洗髓丹，点头说道。
“不错，这一次收徒奖励很给力。”
陆玄很满意。
系统道：“叫爸爸？”
片刻后，陆玄收敛心神，将叶尘唤了过来，他笑着说道。
“叶尘，你是我的第二个徒弟。现在我便送你拜师礼。”
叶尘愣了一下。
陆玄已经取出了天阶洗髓丹，“这是洗髓丹，一会儿你服下，我为你洗髓伐骨，改善体质！”
陆玄将丹药放在了叶尘的手中。
叶尘目瞪口呆，他望着这枚丹药，有些震惊，“一道，两道……九道丹晕！师父，这是什么品阶的洗髓丹？”
陆玄很随意说道，“天阶而已，没什么。”
叶尘一脸不可思议。
天阶丹药！
九道丹晕！
那就是天阶九品了！
卧槽？
他们整个叶家的底蕴恐怕都换不来这一枚丹药！
念及此。
叶尘推辞道。
“师父，这……这太贵重了，我不能要。”
陆玄笑了笑，“同样的丹药，我也给了你大师姐一枚，总不能厚此薄彼啊。”
叶尘身体微微一滞。
大师姐？
大师姐是大帝！
他的心里掀起了滔天巨浪。
叶尘脸上露出犹豫之色，“师父，可……”
陆玄打断道，“收下吧，这东西以后多的是。”
content_en:
Lu Xuan had a thought.
A cold white flame appeared in his palm, with terrifying spiritual seals flowing on it.
Bone-cold ghost fire, strange fire seeds!
Although this is just a strange fire seed, the power it contains is extremely terrifying!
If the ban is lifted, there may be a violent fluctuation.
On the side, Ye Chen was a little shocked.
Such a terrifying spiritual fire!
He saw that the spiritual fire was covered with mysterious seals. Even so, he still felt a chilling force that made his heart palpitate.
Next.
Lu Xuan put away the Bone Cold Fire, and a pill appeared in his palm.
Heavenly Marrow Cleansing Pill!
Cleanse the essence and cut the marrow, improve the qualifications, and make people completely reborn!
Ye Chen was shocked again because he saw several halos on this pill.
And judging from the breath leaking from the elixir, this elixir is probably of extremely high quality!
He swallowed.
Lu Xuan put away the Tianjie Marrow Cleansing Pill, nodded and said.
"Yes, the reward for recruiting a disciple this time is very impressive."
Lu Xuan was very satisfied.
The system asked: "Call me daddy?"
Lu Xuan: "???"
After a while, Lu Xuan gathered his thoughts and called Ye Chen over. He said with a smile.
"Ye Chen, you are my second apprentice. Now I will give you a apprenticeship ceremony."
Ye Chen was stunned for a moment.
Lu Xuan had already taken out the Tianjie Marrow Cleansing Pill, "This is the Marrow Cleansing Pill. You take it in a moment, and I will wash your marrow and cut your bones to improve your physique!"
Lu Xuan put the elixir in Ye Chen's hand.
Ye Chen was stunned. He looked at the elixir and was a little shocked, "One, two... nine elixirs! Master, what grade of marrow-cleansing elixir is this?"
Lu Xuan said casually, "It's just the heaven level, it's nothing."
Ye Chen looked incredulous.
Heaven level elixir!
Nine elixirs faint!
That is the ninth level of heaven level!
Damn it?
Their entire Ye family's background might not be able to exchange for this pill!
Think of this.
Ye Chen declined.
"Master, this... this is too precious, I can't have it."
Lu Xuan smiled and said, "I also gave your senior sister one of the same pills. You can't favor one over the other."
Ye Chen's body froze slightly.
Senior sister?
The eldest sister is the emperor!
There was a huge wave in his heart.
There was hesitation on Ye Chen's face, "Master, but..."
Lu Xuan interrupted, "Take it, there will be more of this in the future."
title_en: Chapter 25 Yaojia Yaoyan Chapter 26 The body is full of weirdness and ominousness
